completeOperativeSource.targets: Your free hand or the free hand of one willing creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect.
completeOperativeSource.duration: Up to 1 hour, until expended or destroyed; no concentration. Expires 3,600 elapsed seconds after application, regardless of initiative changes, absence, death or planar travel.
completeOperativeSource.resolution: Conjure one noncurrency Tiny magical coin, AC10/HP1, mass0.01pound. A current holder with a usable hand may flip and expend it as a Reaction after the complete original roll event has been rolled and its die faces are available under ordinary table information rules, but before that roll's mechanical consequences are applied. Choose one physical die from that completed original roll and reroll only it. There is no separate heads/tails success test. The coin vanishes and its use commits when the legal Reaction begins.
completeOperativeSource.effect: The holder must perceive the creature/object generating the roll or the actual local event being resolved, within 30 feet and line of effect. Physical tabletop dice location is irrelevant. The roll can belong to the holder, an ally or an enemy; no target consent is required. Its result must actually be available to the reacting player under the table’s normal information rules; the coin does not reveal secret rolls or fabricate perception. Choose one physical die from that original roll. Reroll only it and use the new face: for two-d20 advantage/disadvantage reselect the higher/lower normally; for a multi-die damage, healing or resource pool recompute the original total; for a single-die attack/check/save use its new face. All original modifiers, other dice, target selection and source rules remain. If the roll is shared across targets, use the same modified shared result for all of them. An initial Resonance Well reserve d4 may be changed before the reserve is established, but an already established reserve cannot be rerolled or refilled.
completeOperativeSource.scaling: None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.
completeOperativeSource.limitations: One active Fate Coin per caster; successful recasting replaces the previous unspent coin wherever it is. Ordinary handing/dropping/custody and hands apply; a handoff never refreshes the charge, endpoint or caster cap. The spell adds no separate one-coin-per-holder cap: several casters may supply distinct coins, still constrained by actual hands, Reactions and the shared roll guard. At0HP, expiry or replacement, this conjured coin vanishes without creating material; it is not currency, sellable stock or a component. Its native HP is not an Integrity conversion. Ordinary Reaction prohibitions apply. A prevented committed use is not refunded. No already-resolved hit, HP loss, healing, RP grant/transfer, cost or completed outcome can be reversed. The spell grants no character-generation rewrite, out-of-fiction table control, automatic access to hidden Director dice or extra reroll of the entire pool. Mark Omen and Fate Coin share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from either of these two spells, across all casters, coins, marks and recasts. Reserve this allowance at the first legal activation's commitment, not after the replacement die resolves. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. A shared area-damage roll remains one event even when applied to several creatures. Other exact class reroll features keep their own permissions and timing, but do not erase this guard or create a fresh lineage for these two spells. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use a fixed neutral table order chosen before the roll. Only the first legal commitment spends a mark/coin; a later declaration barred by this guard spends nothing. No new Action, roll event, cast, payment or duplicated outcome hook is created by replacing dice. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement, although an applicable concentration transition has already happened. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs commit before the counter window without refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Explicit remote-destination/concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect only as printed. Specific information protections apply to their actual subject and generating-source scope; hidden but unprotected facts are valid information, and missing facts are never invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.

completeOperativeSource.targets: One creature you perceive within30feet and line of effect. No requirement that its alignment be known; hidden canonical axes are resolved after paid casting.
completeOperativeSource.duration: Concentration, up to1minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; an already-passed start never counts. Outside initiative, expires after 60 elapsed seconds. Retain the original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and planar travel; moving between timing modes does not reset it.
completeOperativeSource.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new overlay. Failure: snapshot your actual current alignment orientation. For each axis defined both for you and for the target, compute one step toward your snapshotted value along Lawful–Neutral–Chaotic and Good–Neutral–Evil. Compute the target baseline without any previous Alignment Suggestion overlay on that target and, under the explicitly NEW DI7 AP-AS-01 exception, without any Alignment Purge overlay on that target. Retain all other independent actual alignment effects/records. This target-only exclusion does not change the caster-orientation snapshot: an actual Purge on the caster still makes its effective orientation Neutral/Neutral. An unsuppressed Purge on the target covers the resulting live Suggestion values until Purge ends or is suppressed. An already matching or undefined axis gains no changed-value overlay. If at least one axis changes, replace the prior same-spell overlay with the new recorded axis values/deadline. A failed-save cast that changes no defined axis creates no new overlay and does not itself replace a valid older one; mandatory concentration transitions remain independent.
completeOperativeSource.effect: The changed values are the target’s actual effective canonical alignment for rules that query those axes during the overlay, including real alignment-gated spells/items. Example: baseline Chaotic Evil targeted by a Lawful Good caster becomes Neutral Neutral; one such overlay never jumps two steps. Its values remain fixed until expiry/removal/replacement and do not recompute every time another underlying record changes. Unchanged/unoverlaid axes follow their actual underlying records. An independent effect such as Corrupted can change underlying alignment while this spell persists; that change remains and is exposed when the applicable overlay ends. One Alignment Suggestion overlay per target across casters; recasting cannot use its old overlay as a staircase for another same-spell step.
completeOperativeSource.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
completeOperativeSource.limitations: The spell grants no automatic knowledge of either character’s axes, including whether a value changed. Actual information protections still govern observations. It never compels matching behavior, belief, confession, loyalty, PvP, personality or oathbreaking; conduct clauses still judge actual conduct. Ending removes only this overlay, without restoring an old alignment snapshot, deleting independent changes or reviving a replaced overlay. Caster orientation is fixed at application, not tracked through later caster changes. Ward tag creates no ward. More specific alignment-changing effects retain their actual interaction rules; this card does not invent a general priority engine for every unrelated overlay. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.
